title: geunsia furfuracea
intro: Geunsia furfuracea, commonly known as Wolf's Bane, is a flowering plant in the buttercup family, characterized by its erect stem and yellow flowers with five petals. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including skin issues, such as eczema and acne, due to its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which provide relief and promote wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Geunsia furfuracea include its ability to stimulate blood flow, reduce pain, and exhibit antiviral and antibacterial effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
